meta.name: lark-shared
meta.description: Use for lark-cli setup/auth tasks: auth login/status/logout, user vs bot identity, business-domain permissions (--domain, including all/docs/drive), missing scopes, revoking authorization, or handling _notice JSON.

copy.tagline: 管理飞书 CLI 的认证与权限配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在飞书开放平台使用命令行工具进行认证和权限管理。
copy.tagline_en: Manage Lark CLI authentication and permission configuration
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle Lark CLI authentication and permissions via command line.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你完成飞书 CLI 的配置、登录、权限管理、身份切换等操作，并处理授权链接和二维码。
howto.when: 当你需要配置飞书 CLI、登录/退出、检查权限、处理授权或遇到权限不足错误时触发。

say.text: 帮我用飞书 CLI 登录并获取所有权限。
检查当前飞书 CLI 的登录状态。
帮我撤销对某个 scope 的授权。
say.note: 引导用户手动取消或重新授权

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you configure lark-cli, handle authentication (login/logout/status), manage permissions, switch identity (user/bot), and process authorization URLs and QR codes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to set up lark-cli, perform auth tasks (login/logout/status), check permissions, handle missing scopes, or revoke authorization.

say_en.text: Help me log in to lark-cli with all permissions.
Check the current login status of lark-cli.
Revoke authorization for a specific scope.
say_en.note: Guides user to manually revoke or re-authorize
